summary: fractal doctor no longer reads the whole store for three checks: operation-projection and the admission residue in fleet-admission report the daemon's last background audit and its age, and message-delivery counts late mail from the unread-mail indexes and reads agents from the published roster

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay change.

schema.detail: No table, index or schema version change. The new count reads the existing unread_mail, unread_mail_pending, local_idle_messages and coordination_sends tables.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/doctor returns the same checks with the same names and fields. Two checks now report a background result and its age. (1) operation-projection reports the daemon's last audit: pass when it matched, fail with the drifted keys or the error, warn when no audit has finished since the daemon started or the last one is more than two hours old. The daemon audits at startup, hourly and once after any repair. A projection that drifts between audits shows at the next one, not at the next doctor run. (2) fleet-admission reports the envelopes admitted before this node knew better from a count the daemon makes 30 s after startup and then hourly. When fleet membership has changed since, it reports that count as outdated and wakes the daemon to count again, at most once a minute. It warns before the first count, after a membership change and when the count is more than two hours old, and says why an older count is still accurate. Its live counts, envelopes waiting for a signature and fenced envelopes, are read as before. message-delivery counts the same mail as before, with three differences: a declared message with no message.sent claim no longer counts as late; a message counts as read once any read or closed claim or local mark records it, whatever order its status claims arrived in; and superseded reminder versions, which nothing writes today, would count. While the daemon is still indexing held mail, message-delivery says it did not count late mail. Clients read check statuses and messages as before; no client change is needed.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves. The startup audits run on blocking threads after it does.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is safe: the previous release runs these checks inline again. Nothing is written that it reads.
